Definition: of uncertain derivation; a stain or blemish, i.e. (figuratively) defect, disgrace:--spot.
BiblicalUsage: A spot is a blemish, and the two uses are the church's warning and the church's hope. The false teachers are spots and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you, but Christ will present the church to Himself glorious, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the church Christ presents will have no spot, and the spots among us now are the reason to watch.
